items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Billie Holiday? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Billie Holiday. Billie Holiday…what‘s that chick player, or was a man that played piano that stand up and played, and sang and played? He was very good, he was famous, man.
